subject_rule: The call sets no list of fields: scholarships are for full-time, in-person study or research at the Annex 1 institutions, and selection gives preference (not exclusive access) to research on sustainable food systems, ending violence and discrimination against women and girls, water management, renewable energy, inequalities and human rights, sustainable consumption, climate change and protection of ecosystems; the call does not say the field of study is open to any subject.
notes: No programmes recorded for any level: neither the call nor its annexes name programmes. Annex 1 (2026 update) lists 103 institutions, numbered 1 to 104 in the document with number 99 missing; it gives no programmes.

The official page says about 90 institutions take part and all have programmes registered in the national postgraduate system; the Annex 1 list holds 103 institutions, so the two counts differ.

The programme-by-institution list sits in the Instituciones Participantes section of the applicant system after sign-in (as the applicant manual describes it); it was not read because it needs an account.
The preference themes in the call apply to research stays; the call also says a thesis-writing-only scholarship is not offered.

fetch_problems: The applicant system that holds the participating institutions and their programmes needs a login, so its list was not read and no access was attempted.
No official PDF or web version of the programme list was found on the scholarship page or in the annexes.
